# Adam Dittrich

<p class="ac-role">Assistant Professor · Department of Economic History<br>Prague University of Economics and Business</p>

I work on monetary and financial history and the history of economic thought, with a particular focus on interwar Czechoslovakia and Central Europe. My research combines archival sources with historical data reconstruction and econometrics.

My current projects examine exchange rates and monetary policy during the Great Depression, banking and financial stress, and the work of Czech economists such as Karel Engliš and Jan Loevenstein. I also contribute to comparative research on historical national accounts.
